verdict.rationale: Docs describe Kosmos as autonomously reading literature, writing/executing analysis code, generating hypotheses, and producing a comprehensive cited multi-step report, plus other agents (Precedent, Molecules) that perform multi-step autonomous investigation rather than single-pass summaries. Quickstart shows a real client workflow (run_tasks_until_done) confirming this is an actual product capability, not just marketing. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of multi-step autonomy beyond vendor docs, and one probe returned a 404 for the cookbook page raising minor doc-consistency concerns.
